description: The pie chart presents the distribution of emotion categories in the dataset referenced by “Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech,” showing 6 slices in total: Frustration (light blue/cyan) at about 25.1%, Neutral (blue/purple) at about 23.1%, Anger (yellow) at about 14.9%, Sadness (orange) at about 14.7%, Fear (red) at about 14.1%, and Happiness (medium blue) at about 8.1%. Percentage values are printed inside each slice, there is no separate legend visible, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slices appear arranged roughly from larger segments near the top (Frustration and Neutral) to smaller ones, with Happiness being the smallest.
